conclusion: Two distinct roots. PR198 lacks parameter docs; PR203..212 fail combined documentation resource processing. Of 22 runs: 18 combined 8MiB failures, one combined-check OOM, two parameter-coverage failures, one unavailable specific job log.

roots.evidence: Both PR198 jobs report CJDOC3004 at src/http/client.cj:92 and src/http/server.cj:360. HttpClientBuilder.resourceLimits and HttpServerBuilder.resourceLimits omit @param value. Coverage is symbols 1116/1116, parameters 522/524.
roots.exactFix: Add @param value The per-instance aggregate resource limits for this client/server to the two public resourceLimits comments.
roots.currentSource: Both comments already repaired at selected top head; no new source change needed.
roots.publication: PR198 is an isolated earlier head. Repair it only through separately authorized new M10-002 branch if desired; preserve all existing 14 publication heads. Current independent M7-033 repair must not incorporate deadline implementation or modify PR198.
verification: Using qualified STS 1.1.3 and pinned cjdoc 0.7.2 in isolated validation checkout: scripts/check-docs --html --json --output build/ci-repair-docs.json
roots.expected: No CJDOC3004; all public symbol and parameter coverage 100%; full HTML.

roots.evidence: 18 jobs fail combined strict cjdoc check with JSON value exceeds 8388608 bytes. PR212 docs job fails that same combined check with Out of memory. Prior per-package checks/generation succeed.
roots.diagnosis: tools/docs/m7_033_docs.py copies all public files into combined/project then invokes _check before combined generation and HTML. This all-public operation breaches pinned JSON bounds. OOM is the same failing stage but logs do not prove identical allocation cause.
sourceSections: scripts/check-code:14 calls docs before cjpm check/build/test
roots.fix: Parallel worker owns bounded documentation processing and deterministic full artifact assembly. Preserve strict 100% parameter/symbol coverage, full Doc IR/API surface/Markdown, HTML/search, drift checks, pinned tool/version and limits; never skip HTML or raise limits.
roots.publication: User-selected independent M7-033 repair PR; preserve all 14 existing publication heads.
roots.expected: Exercise changed actual CLI on selected complete source with qualified STS 1.1.3 and pinned cjdoc 0.7.2, complete strict artifacts including HTML/search and no oversized/OOM processing; run both workflows on independent authorized branch.
